ops.text: c. TrueLink shall defend and indemnify Client against any third-party claim alleging that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, excluding any claim arising from Client's modifications of the foregoing, Client's combination of the foregoing with other products or services, or Client's specifications. TrueLink shall, at its option, procure for Client the right to continue using the affected item, modify the affected item, or replace the affected item, and if none of the foregoing is available, refund the fees paid for the affected item. TrueLink's total liability under this Section 12(c) shall not exceed 3x the annual fees paid by Client under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12(b) covers only TrueLink's breach of the Agreement, so we added a TrueLink IP infringement indemnity at our fallback position, with the usual Client modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap. We have left our own Section 12(a) indemnity and the balance of Section 12 untouched.
proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink IP indemnity with standard exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap.
